name: Kurotsume Yotsuba
source:
A school-setting novel game about searching for the extraordinary. 

"Aren't four leaf clovers supposed to mean good luck?"

June 1st, 2012

Nogami Uika appears before our protagonist Furuyari Ryuhei, a second year high school student. They run into each other on a street corner, and the same day she transfers into Ryuehi's class. 
Their meeting is like a cliche' event from a manga.

Ryuhei was fascinated by what she said to him, and as he gradually gets to know her, he also becomes involved in various incidents.  

An early summer story, brought together by clovers.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210728224921/http://mochioto.com/product.html]Homepage[/url]]
